title: Localization manifest (committed: l10n/manifest.json)
description: Per-document ledger: last-localized revision, unit inventory (RETIRE GC reference counts), per-language completion. See .claude/rules/l10n-pipeline-spec.md §6.

schema.description: Format discriminator; bump on breaking change.

languages.description: Target languages of the pipeline (he, ru).

files.description: Keyed by repo-relative source path under md/. Serialize with sorted keys.

source_blob.description: Git blob SHA of the last-localized source revision; step 3 recovers the old markdown via `git show <blob>`. Unreachable blob ⇒ plan against the empty document (degenerate case, spec §1).

doc_hash.description: Merkle root of the canonicalized document (tree_diff.hash_tree on the root node) — cheap whole-document change check.

unit_hashes.description: Ordered unit hashes at the last-localized revision (document order). Reference counts for RETIRE garbage collection: a TM entry is deleted only when no file lists its hash.

opaque_hashes.description: Hashes of opaque blocks (fence / code_block / html_block / front_matter / hr) at the last-localized revision. Never in the TM; listed for change accounting.

localized.description: Per-language completion state; a language absent here has never completed a run for this file.

run_id.description: The run that produced the currently committed locales/<lang> rendering of this file.

fallbacks.description: Unit hashes rendered as English source because their job ended rejected (spec §5). Empty when fully localized.
